title: Import full XML suite and classify strict subset metadata
api_or_output: Pinned full XML suite metadata, sources/provenance/checksums and reproducible frozen-contract feature classification; no product parser execution claims

acceptance.description: Import full authoritative XML conformance suite metadata and required source fixtures with pinned source/revision/checksum/license provenance; preserve every discovered test identity including invalid and external-resource cases. Reuse verified corpus schema/provisioning; no incomplete bootstrap substitution or silent file/case loss.

Classify M1-supported cases from frozen feature contracts and metadata/source syntax requirements rather than product pass/fail; emit complete reproducible discovery totals, explicit visible later-capability gaps and classification reasons. Preserve unsupported/infrastructure outcomes distinctly; classification never claims parser execution or standards passes.

Demonstrate full pinned inventory and required resource containment/checksums with meaningful positive/negative/offline provisioning and classification checks through verified infrastructure; preserve earlier bootstrap discovery and publish owned report/consumer format for runtime conformance join. Run planning validation and committed/working/untracked owned-path audit at known revision.

handoff.summary: Independent full-suite metadata/provisioning lane split before claim; runtime corpus conformance/round trips stay M1-corpus after verified DOM/serializer.
